name: Code Marketplace
headline: Code Marketplace - Automate Code Quality
short_description: Automate code quality checks and extract skills from codebases. Operations teams use it to enforce standards and document expertise. Integrates with Claude Code Hooks and Subagents.
author: takahirom

sections.overview:
takahirom-claude-code-marketplace provides two integrated plugins: claude-code-quality-gate and skill-extractor. The quality-gate plugin uses Claude Code Hooks and Subagents to automatically enforce code quality standards across projects. The skill-extractor plugin captures learnings from conversations and saves them as reusable, documented skills for future use. Together, these tools help operations teams maintain consistent code standards while building a library of organizational expertise.
Automatically enforce code quality standards in development workflows
Extract and document domain expertise as reusable skills
Implement quality gates using Claude Code Hooks for continuous validation
Build organizational skill libraries from conversation learnings
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/takahirom/takahirom-claude-code-marketplace`
sections.usage:
```
Analyze the following codebase from [COMPANY] in the [INDUSTRY] sector. Identify 5 key technical skills required to maintain this codebase and suggest 3 quality improvements. Format your response with clear headers and bullet points.
```

requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
